lead: A calm daily scan of New Orleans with 36 fresh links across news, dining, entertainment, music, and 12 event picks, plus the latest local forecast.

current_forecast.name: Overnight
current_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy. Low around 74, with temperatures rising to around 76 overnight. Southwest wind around 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 20%. New rainfall amounts less than a tenth of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Thursday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms before 10am, then showers and thunderstorms likely between 10am and noon, then a chance of showers and thunderstorms between noon and 4pm. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 81. Northwest wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 70%. New rainfall amounts between a tenth and quarter of an inch possible.

seven_day_forecast.name: Friday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms after 10am. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 77. East wind 5 to 10 mph. Chance of precipitation is 50%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Saturday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Showers and thunderstorms. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 80. South wind around 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 90%.

seven_day_forecast.name: Sunday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny, with a high near 83. Southwest wind around 5 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Monday
seven_day_forecast.short_forecast: Slight Chance Showers And Thunderstorms then Mostly Sunny
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: A slight chance of showers and thunderstorms before 7am. Mostly sunny, with a high near 81. North wind 10 to 15 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Tuesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Sunny, with a high near 78. Northeast wind 5 to 10 mph.

seven_day_forecast.name: Wednesday
seven_day_forecast.detailed_forecast: Sunny, with a high near 82. East wind 0 to 5 mph.
